title: Alljoined1
description: Alljoined1 is an EEG dataset capturing neural responses from eight healthy adults viewing natural images in a rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) paradigm with an oddball detection task, designed to support EEG-to-image decoding research. Stimuli were drawn from the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD), itself derived from MS-COCO, with 960 shared images presented across one or two sessions per participant. The dataset provides raw 64-channel BioSemi EEG recordings in BDF format along with derivative epoched data preprocessed by the original authors.
methods_description: EEG was recorded using a 64-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system (Ag/AgCl sintered electrodes, International 10-20 montage) with 24-bit A/D conversion at 512 Hz sampling rate, referenced to CMS/DRL with average reference applied during preprocessing. Participants viewed images for 300 ms followed by 300 ms black screen with jitter, performing an oddball detection task. Original preprocessing included 0.5-125 Hz band-pass filtering, 60 Hz notch filtering, FastICA-based artifact removal, epoch extraction (-50 to 600 ms), AutoReject-based artifact rejection, baseline correction, and average re-referencing.
